entities.summary: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad al-Maqqarī al-Tilmisānī, (1577-1632) was an Algerian scholar, biographer and historian who is best known for his Nafh at-Tib ,S a compendium of the history of Al-Andalus which provided a basis for the scholarly research on the subject until the twentieth century.
